Product Details: The 152mm x 95mm 6V 300mAh Mini Solar Panel is a high-efficiency, compact polycrystalline solar cell designed for low-voltage power generation in educational and DIY electronics projects. Encased in a durable epoxy coating, this panel converts sunlight into usable energy, delivering up to 6V at 300mAh under optimal lighting conditions. Ideal for powering small devices such as solar-powered fans, LED lights, microcontrollers, battery chargers, and more, this panel is commonly used in STEM kits, school science experiments, and IoT applications, and off-grid prototypes. Its flat, rectangular shape fits easily into enclosures or onto model surfaces. With its water-resistant epoxy resin finish, the panel can be used in both indoor and light outdoor settings. It features solder tabs or terminal wires for quick connection and can be configured in series or parallel to match custom voltage/current requirements.
